# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road leading toward [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), famous for its arch of old, wide-spreading apple trees that form a snowy, fragrant canopy over a purple twilight air.

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) drives the young girl through the Avenue and past local landmarks like Barry's pond as she chatters animatedly and renames the sights around them. She successfully guesses which house is [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), filling her with joy while [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) dreads the moment she learns the truth about the mistake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is a rural community where [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), home to [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Lovers' Lane are located.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). Later, the children perform in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where [Anne](../character/anne.md) excels in her recitations, despite her initial nerves. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) discuss Anne's performance by the kitchen fire and consider her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), located in town, where [Anne](../character/anne.md) stays while taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

**Associated with:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission to go, the girls travel to Beechwood, Aunt Josephine's estate, where they enjoy several days of town festivities, concerts, and dining out. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects warmly on the trip and her joy at returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

## Bingen {#bingen}

Bingen is a location on the [Rhine](../codex/places.md#rhine) referenced in the title of a poem recited by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and known by heart by [Anne](../character/anne.md).

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana.md), the Birch Path is a narrow, scenic woodland trail fringed with white birches and wild flora that runs through Mr. Bell's woods to the main road, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Diana's picturesque route to school.

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk along Birch Path on Anne's thirteenth birthday, discussing growing up, school assignments, and romantic story plots. [Anne](../character/anne.md) proposes starting a story club to cultivate their imaginations, which eventually expands to include other classmates like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the story club's progress, defending their work and sharing her aspirations to be like Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to finish her household chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a town in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born in a small yellow house, and where her parents, [Walter](../character/walter.md) and [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), worked as high school teachers before both dying of fever.

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a city where a cousin of [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's mother resides and is married to a man who attended school with a distinguished, romantic-looking artist.

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location eight miles from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a train station house with a long platform and a small hotel with a yard.

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the Bright River train station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but instead finds an imaginative, talkative young girl waiting for him. Learning from the stationmaster that there has been a mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) decides to take her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) handle the situation. As they drive away together in the buggy, the young girl chatters enthusiastically about her life, her wild imaginations, and her distress over her red hair.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is a romantic, historical setting featured in Tennyson's poetry, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) envies for its old-fashioned romance and incorporates into a dramatic game with her friends.

## Canada {#canada}

Canada is a nation governed from Ottawa whose political affairs are a frequent topic of debate among electors like Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md).

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby location that hosts meetings for the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society).

## Charlottetown {#charlottetown}

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) where travelers can board a train and observe the area's distinctive red roads.

**Associated with:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md)

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

The Dryad's Bubble is a spring located in a hollow near a log bridge and a spruce path that leads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), named by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) after a spring in a story.

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a tearful, romantic farewell after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Consoled by their devotion and a exchanged lock of hair, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and receives a secret note of friendship from [Diana](../character/diana.md). She dedicates herself to her studies, engaging in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while maintaining her silence toward him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

Edward Island, also referred to as Prince Edward Island, is a region where custom dictates that travelers nod to everyone they meet on the road.

## England {#england}

England is a distant location mentioned by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as a place far enough from the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) that adopting a child from there might yield someone quite different from local residents.

## Entrance {#entrance}

The Entrance is an examination taken by advanced students to qualify for admission into Queen's.

**Participants:** [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a destination mentioned by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her fictional story as the place where the wealthy character [Bertram](../character/bertram.md) DeVere planned to take his bride for a wedding tour.

## Exhibition {#exhibition}

The Exhibition is an event held in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to which [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) invited [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to visit and stay with her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

**Participants:** [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

## Germany {#germany}

Germany is a foreign country and the homeland from which a traveling peddler was working hard to bring his wife and children.

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family homestead in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a big, rambling house situated at the far edge of their cleared land at the end of a long, grassy lane.

**Associated with:** [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) suspects [Anne](../character/anne.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne.md) fabricates a dramatic story about losing the brooch in the water, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway as punishment. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne.md), and quickly sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) up to bed and instructs her on keeping her room tidy and saying her bedtime prayers. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has never said a prayer, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to invent one, resulting in an unconventional prayer from [Anne](../character/anne.md). Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) that they must properly educate and raise the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake in suspecting [Anne](../character/anne.md) and forgives her for the false confession, quickly sending her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns overjoyed after having a wonderful time eating ice cream and boating on the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shares the entire story with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), admitting she learned a valuable lesson.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana.md) over for tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne.md) inadvertently serves [Diana](../character/diana.md) three glassfuls of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana.md) to feel dizzy and sick and go home early. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together, whereupon [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the wine bottle and realizes her mistake in storing it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in his finest clothes, sparking her curiosity. She visits Green Gables to investigate and learns from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) on the farm. Mrs. Rachel expresses strong disapproval and warns [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) of the risks involved before departing to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

## Haunted Wood {#haunted-wood}

The Haunted Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) imaginatively populated with romantic ghosts, including a wailing white lady, a murdered child's ghost near [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), a headless man, and skeletons.

## Hopeton {#hopeton}

Hopeton is a place where Mrs. Alexander Spencer's cousin lives and the location of an orphan asylum.

## Idlewild {#idlewild}

Idlewild is the poetical name invented by [Anne](../character/anne.md) for the playhouse she and [Diana](../character/diana.md) set up in a ring of white birch trees on Mr. William Bell's land.

## Island {#island}

The Island is a region located close to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), where local residents contrast its native-born populace with those from places such as [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton), [England](../codex/places.md#england), or the [States](../codex/places.md#states).

## London {#london}

London is a city associated with street Arabs, whose orphaned youth are viewed with skepticism by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) in comparison to native-born Canadians.

## Lover {#lover}

Lover's Lane is a romantic pathway opening below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, extending into the woods to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, which [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) use as part of their scenic walk to school.

## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a depression where the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road dips down, featuring a home, an orchard, a quiet brook fringed with alders and ladies’ eardrops, and a view of the steep red hill road leading out of the peninsula.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived and briefly attended school until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

Taking place on a snowy morning, Merry Christmas was a festive occasion marked by [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gifting [Anne](../character/anne.md) a fashionable brown dress with puffed sleeves made by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) sending her kid slippers, and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars successfully staging an evening concert.

## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a region where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visited his cousins over the summer and the location of a tragic incident in which an adopted girl poisoned her family's well.

## Newbridge {#newbridge}

Newbridge is a bustling little village featuring a tree-canopied stretch of road called the "[Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue)" that leads down a long slope into the town.

## Nova Scotia {#nova-scotia}

Nova Scotia is a Canadian region home to an orphan asylum, situated close to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and her family, featuring a house with a western gable located up through a brook and the firs from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

**Associated with:** [Diana](../character/diana.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her mistake with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before going to Orchard Slope to take the blame directly. She bravely confronts the angry Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and explains her perspective, winning over the old lady with her sincerity and imagination. [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all, and she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) become firm friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on the pond, but the dory leaks and begins to sink, forcing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to cling to a bridge pile. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rows by and rescues her, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) angrily refuses his offer of apology and friendship. Later, back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on learning her lesson about romance, while [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) gently advises her not to abandon it entirely.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

## Queen’s Academy {#queen-s-academy}

Queen’s Academy is an educational institution located in town where students pursue classwork and teacher's licenses, as well as compete for honors such as medals and the Avery scholarship.

**Associated with:** [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md), Wilson

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) adjusts to life at Queen's Academy, forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while continuing her intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys weekend visits home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during the autumn and spends spare time visiting [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final exams loom, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends gather to discuss their anxieties, upcoming commencement clothes, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

## Redmond College {#redmond-college}

Redmond College is an institution of higher learning that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was eligible to attend using her scholarship before deciding to forego her studies there to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

**Associated with:** [Anne](../character/anne.md)

## Rhine {#rhine}

The Rhine is a location mentioned in the poem "[Bingen](../codex/places.md#bingen) on the Rhine," which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) has memorized and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) recites at a concert.

## Rome {#rome}

_Not yet known._

## Shining Waters {#shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is a long, winding body of water—locally known as Barry's pond—spanned by a bridge and surrounded by sand-hills, marshland, and groves of fir and maple.

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

The Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the exceptionally white, blooming cherry tree located outside her bedroom window.

## Spain {#spain}

Spain is a place associated with the imaginary, glittering castles that [Anne](../character/anne.md) shapes out of the mists and rainbows of her lively fancy while daydreaming by the fire.

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a nearby locale whose resident physician attended to [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during her bout with croup and later advised [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's health.

**Associated with:** [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md)

## States {#states}

The States is a foreign region where French farm workers frequently relocate after learning local agricultural practices, located at a greater distance from Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) than [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a ravishing spot discovered by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) up the brook, featuring two maple trees and surrounded by the flowing brook, which they named in honor of finding it on the Queen's birthday.

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Violet Vale is a green dimple in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's woods, named by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that sits along the scenic route she and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) take to school and is said to be filled with millions of violets in the spring.

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

The White Sands Hotel is a large establishment run by Mr. Kirke along the shore, popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) tourists visiting for the summer season.

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) dress for a concert performance at the White Sands Hotel, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offers her usual blunt observations before [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves with [Diana](../character/diana.md), Jane, and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). Upon arriving at the grand hotel, [Anne](../character/anne.md) experiences intense stage fright while waiting among sophisticated performers and audience members. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, her pride kicks in, allowing her to deliver a brilliant recitation that wins over the audience and earns her high praise.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## White Way {#white-way}

The White Way of Delight is the imaginative name given by [Anne](../character/anne.md) to a wonderful, wonderfully beautiful place known locally as the [Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue).

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a scenic location situated past Mr. Barry's back field along the romantic route that [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school.
